name: LED strip profile (channel)
definition: Rigid channel, usually aluminium, with a diffuser cover, made to hold and finish a strip light; sold without the strip.
reason: Part made for the strip light, follows it (S3, memo 9.10). Page must show profiles sold to house LED strips.
Same object as the LED strip profile; aluminium is its material, an attribute (C2(b)).

name: Mobile light tower
definition: Towed or wheeled unit with a raised mast of floodlights, often with its own generator, set up to light a work or event site.
reason: Made to give light (step 30, any capacity); mast-and-base body unlike any floodlight (C12 M(a)). Page must show towers sold.

name: Balloon light
reason: Generic site and event form, not maker-bound; one sold for film or video is D4 (K-17). No URL given; needs a fetched page.
A pole sold alone to carry a lamp head is the lamp base (stand sold alone); outdoor is setting. Complete post light is B3.1.4.02.
A table lamp with salt crystal as material (C2(b); memo 9.14, F-25 stone lamp). One sold to treat a condition is H2.
Post or mast light with power source solar (C10, Appendix A); harvester already filed it so.

name: High-bay light
definition: Heavy fitting with a wide reflector or heat-sink body, hung or fixed under a high roof to light a large floor (warehouse, workshop, garage); mounting height is an attribute.
reason: Body made for high mounting, unlike a pendant or flush light (C12 M(a)). Page must show high-bay fittings sold as their own category.
Same body for lower ceilings; mounting height is an attribute of the high-bay light (C6).
In scope (key step 30; market a modifier). Recessed grid-module fitting that swaps with the LED panel in one slot (C10(b)); widen wording, alias row.
Wall-mounted outdoor area light: the floodlight kind (wall bracket an installation attribute); wall pack is a trade name, alias (C9).
Low fitting fixed flat under a canopy or garage ceiling: flush ceiling light; outdoor and commercial are modifiers.
Made for growing plants: key step 29 precedes step 30; memo 9.3, C-14 (one C2 kind). Full-spectrum lamp not sold for plants stays B3.
All swimming-pool equipment is C2 (key step 29, K-176).
Boat navigation and underwater hull lights are parts of the vessel (S3, G1), as vehicle lamps (memo 9.4).
Fitted to a mast or building as a regulatory warning to aircraft, not to light a space: building supply with safety signs (step 32, K-192).
Ground marker lights fitted to a landing pad, part of the structure as built: building supply (step 32), as obstruction lights.
Illuminated and shop signs are B4 (key B4 branch); sign light modules follow the sign (S3).
Ceiling fans, even with lights, are B7 (B7 branch precedes B3; memo 9.5).
Tunable white or colour is light colour, an attribute (C10) of every fitting and bulb kind; no kind of its own.
Examination and surgical lights are made for health care (key step 2), as hospital furniture (K-190).
